description.en: The Blightbearer has been twisted by Illager witches to spread plague and disease.
description.zh-Hant: 瘟疫使者遭到刌民女巫扭曲，會散播瘟疫與疾病。

description.en: The Wiki does not document what this unused artifact was meant to do.
description.zh-Hant: Wiki 未記載這件未使用神器原本的用途。

description.en: [PASSIVE] When equipped, slowly replenishes your arrows up to 20.
description.zh-Hant: [被動] 裝備時會逐漸補充箭矢，最多補至 20 支。

description.en: [PASSIVE] When equipped, getting hit by arrows gives you a chance to gain that arrow.
description.zh-Hant: [被動] 裝備時，受到箭矢攻擊有機會獲得該箭矢。

description.en: This unused artifact's function was replaced by the Totem of Regeneration.
description.zh-Hant: 這件未使用神器的功能後來由再生圖騰取代。

description.en: The Wiki does not document what this unused artifact was meant to do.
description.zh-Hant: Wiki 未記載這件未使用神器原本的用途。

description.en: The Totem of Resistance buzzes with self-destructive energy that bursts forth to protect you, at all costs.
description.zh-Hant: 抗性圖騰嗡鳴著自我毀滅的能量，會不惜一切代價爆發力量保護你。

description.en: This totem radiates powerful protective magic.
description.zh-Hant: 這座圖騰散發著強大的防護魔法。

description.en: Heals 20% over 3 seconds
description.zh-Hant: 在 3 秒內恢復 20% 生命值。

description.en: Heals 100% over 30 seconds
description.zh-Hant: 在 30 秒內恢復 100% 生命值。

description.en: Heals 30% over 1 second
description.zh-Hant: 在 1 秒內恢復 30% 生命值。

description.en: Heals 35% over 8 seconds
description.zh-Hant: 在 8 秒內恢復 35% 生命值。

description.en: Heals 75% over 15 seconds
description.zh-Hant: 在 15 秒內恢復 75% 生命值。

description.en: Heals 50% over 10 seconds
description.zh-Hant: 在 10 秒內恢復 50% 生命值。

description.en: Heals 20% over 8 seconds and grants Swiftness for 5 seconds
description.zh-Hant: 在 8 秒內恢復 20% 生命值，並獲得 5 秒迅捷效果。

description.en: Heals 20% over 2 seconds and replenishes 10% oxygen
description.zh-Hant: 在 2 秒內恢復 20% 生命值，並補充 10% 氧氣。

description.en: This unused food was planned for the Hidden Depths DLC; the Wiki does not record its intended effect.
description.zh-Hant: 這種未使用食物原定加入隱藏深淵 DLC；Wiki 未記載其預定效果。

description.en: Its use sound echoes the Swiftness Potion effect, suggesting it may have increased movement speed.
description.zh-Hant: 使用音效帶有迅捷藥水效果的旋律，顯示它可能原本會提高移動速度。

description.en: A spicy sip will set you aflame! Damages enemies that get too close.
description.zh-Hant: 辛辣一飲，讓你燃起火焰！傷害靠得太近的敵人。

description.en: Grants resistance to pushbacks and melee damage.
description.zh-Hant: 獲得擊退抗性，並減少近戰傷害。

description.en: Briefly boosts defense
description.zh-Hant: 短暫提高防禦。

description.en: Grants the ability to breathe freely underwater for a limited time.
description.zh-Hant: 在有限時間內可於水下自由呼吸。

description.en: Grants invisibility and boosts your next melee attack
description.zh-Hant: 獲得隱形效果，並強化下一次近戰攻擊。

description.en: Briefly boosts attack damage.
description.zh-Hant: 短暫提高攻擊傷害。

description.en: Grants a small defense boost and resistance to freezing effects.
description.zh-Hant: 小幅提高防禦，並獲得冰凍抗性。

description.en: Briefly boosts movement speed.
description.zh-Hant: 短暫提高移動速度。

description.en: Sets your arrows on fire and makes them pierce through enemies, making them vastly more dangerous.
description.zh-Hant: 讓你的箭矢燃起火焰並貫穿敵人，使它們危險得多。

description.en: This unused potion would have dropped during missions, but its intended status effect is unknown.
description.zh-Hant: 這種未使用藥水原定於任務中掉落，但其預定狀態效果未知。

description.en: A potion that restores health.
description.zh-Hant: 一瓶可恢復生命值的藥水。

description.en: This unused potion would have dropped during missions; its intended status effect is unknown.
description.zh-Hant: 這種未使用藥水原定於任務中掉落；其預定狀態效果未知。

description.en: This unused potion would have dropped during missions; its intended status effect is unknown.
description.zh-Hant: 這種未使用藥水原定於任務中掉落；其預定狀態效果未知。

description.en: This unused throwable potion would have dropped during missions, but its intended status effect is unknown.
description.zh-Hant: 這種未使用投擲藥水原定於任務中掉落，但其預定狀態效果未知。

description.en: When thrown, slows all enemies in an area.
description.zh-Hant: 投擲後會使範圍內所有敵人減速。

description.en: A small bundle of arrows
description.zh-Hant: 一小捆箭矢。

description.en: Creates a sphere of oxygenated water, protecting players from drowning.
description.zh-Hant: 形成一個充滿氧氣的水球，保護玩家免於溺水。

description.en: Sticks to the first target it hits, then explodes a few seconds later.
description.zh-Hant: 黏附於第一個命中的目標，並在數秒後爆炸。

description.en: Grants the ability to blast off and glide.
description.zh-Hant: 可讓你彈射升空並滑翔。

description.en: One of three unused scroll consumables; its intended use is unknown.
description.zh-Hant: 三種未使用捲軸消耗品之一；預定用途未知。

description.en: This unused item's function was replaced by the hotbar ability to teleport to other players.
description.zh-Hant: 這件未使用物品的功能後來由快捷列傳送至其他玩家的能力取代。

description.en: In The Stronghold, collecting all six Eyes of Ender opens the End portal and grants access to the End Wilds.
description.zh-Hant: 在要塞中收集全部六顆終界之眼即可開啟終界傳送門，前往終界荒野。

description.en: One of three unused scroll consumables; its intended use is unknown.
description.zh-Hant: 三種未使用捲軸消耗品之一；預定用途未知。

description.en: This unused consumable's intended function is unknown.
description.zh-Hant: 這件未使用消耗品的預定功能未知。

description.en: Planned for the Echoing Void DLC, this unused item's intended function is unknown.
description.zh-Hant: 這件未使用物品原定加入回音虛空 DLC，但預定功能未知。

description.en: Its function was likely replaced by the Gold Key Golem and Diamond Key Golem.
description.zh-Hant: 它的功能很可能後來由金鑰匙魔像與鑽石鑰匙魔像取代。

description.en: This unused staff is mentioned in the opening and ending cinematics of Desert Temple; its function is unknown.
description.zh-Hant: 這支未使用法杖曾在沙漠神殿的開場與結尾動畫中提及；其功能未知。

description.en: One of three unused scroll consumables; the Wiki does not record its intended effect.
description.zh-Hant: 三種未使用捲軸消耗品之一；Wiki 未記載其預定效果。

description.en: Collecting a Threat Banner increases the threat level of the mission instantly!
description.zh-Hant: 取得威脅旗幟會立即提高任務的威脅等級！
